title: Oracle C2M Hypercare & Production Support Runbook (Go-Live Readiness)
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (Oracle Utilities C2M + WebLogic 14c administration; middleware/database/integration work, production-impact care).

Oracle Utilities C2M/CC&B/MDM + WebLogic 14c authored from Oracle's official product + OUAF docs; version-specific details (C2M 25.4/min v2.9, WebLogic 14c) cited or flagged 'verify for your version'; My-Oracle-Support-gated patches/notes are pointed to, not reproduced. Automation is WLST (Jython)/shell/SQL, not PowerShell.
hook: Go live on C2M — and survive hypercare with a runbook
problem: The riskiest weeks of any C2M program are go-live and hypercare. This solution provides the hypercare and production-support runbook: go-live readiness checks, the on-call and escalation model, incident and known-issue handling, day-2 build support in lower environments, and the monitoring/health routine — so the team runs production confidently from cutover through stabilization.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the hypercare operating model (readiness → cutover → hypercare → steady-state) and the production-support structure.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (monitoring, on-call rota, escalation contacts, runbook access, lower-environment access for day-2).
Runbook — go-live readiness checklist, on-call/escalation model, incident + known-issue handling, day-2 build support in lower environments, and the daily health/monitoring routine, with gates.

5 automation scripts (WLST/Jython, shell & SQL) — environment/config discovery, per-node validation, a health/coverage report, safe remediation (dry-run by default), and a scope/target helper — authentic to C2M & WebLogic administration.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (readiness met, incidents handled, health stable) plus Best Practices for a smooth stabilization.
short: The C2M hypercare and production-support runbook — go-live readiness, on-call/escalation, incident handling, day-2 support, and health routine — so the team runs production confidently from cutover. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
